image_description: A close-up, low-angle view of a weathered white metal railing (bannister) running along the edge of a concrete walkway or bridge. The railing consists of vertical tubular balusters welded to a horizontal base rail and topped with a handrail. Significant rust stains are visible at the weld points where the balusters meet the base. The background features blurred green foliage and a wooden fence.
